name: Avatares AI - Content - Create Publication Draft

parameters.jsCode: const row=$input.first()?.json||{}; if(!row.draft_id)return[{json:{ok:false,created:false,error:'No approved/generated/canonical asset found for draft'}}]; let hashtags=row.hashtags||[]; if(typeof hashtags==='string'){try{hashtags=JSON.parse(hashtags)}catch{hashtags=[]}} return[{json:{ok:true,created:true,draft:{draftId:row.draft_id,avatar:row.avatar,scene:row.scene,assetType:row.asset_type,platform:row.platform,assetId:row.asset_id,generatedAssetId:row.generated_asset_id,imageUrl:row.image_url,caption:row.caption,hashtags,status:row.status,createdAt:row.created_at}}}];
